text:
Maria: quick async check-in: what I did yesterday — cleaned up the lite-sdk quickstart, fixed the Windows install note and added a tiny troubleshooting section for the venv path issue. Pushed draft PR #4128.

Jake: thanks! can you paste the snippet you added for the venv fix? a few folks hit that on the sample app CI.

Maria: sure — short snippet below that I added to the quickstart:
```bash
# if pip installs to a global path on windows, try explicitly creating venv then activate
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Sasha: small note — CI still flakes on the sampleapp on macOS runner (M1). the error looks like this: `ImportError: symbol not found: _PyGen_Send` during the wheel install step. I left details on the PR.

Maria: saw that, thinking it's the wheel we vendor for tokenizers. plan: add `--no-binary :all:` fallback in the quickstart and doc the slower path.

Lee: blocker for me — I need a docs owner to update the quickstart landing TOC. the new headings changed and anchor links 404. @maria can you add the anchor update or should I open a tiny follow-up?

Maria: I can do it today. will update TOC + add a note under "Troubleshooting" about the M1 wheel fallback.

Jake: tagging docs-bot: can we trigger a link-check run after the PR merges? would like that green before we publish the quickstart. :eyes:

docs-bot: link-checker queued for PR #4128 — running on merge candidate. Results will post back here.

Sasha: quick FYI — sampleapp smoke test (local dev) now passes if you run the new `make dev-sanity` target I added. command: `make dev-sanity` — it runs the lite-sdk build + a minimal inference smoke call against the mock server.

Maria: awesome, can you add that command to the quickstart under "Run locally"? makes it easier for new devs.

Sasha: on it, will push a tiny commit to #4128.

Lee: plan for today: 1) merge the TOC fix + anchor updates, 2) coordinate with infra on a new macOS runner image if the wheel fallback is too slow for CI. I'll follow up in infra channel if I need help.

Maria: blockers: none blocking me once the PR review is done. will address any follow-ups from docs-bot.

Jake: I'll review #4128 now. if everything looks ok I'll approve and request the link-check run.

Sasha: post-merge work: iterate on making the sampleapp Dockerfile smaller — opened issue so we don't forget.

Maria: thanks team. small ask — if you hit the M1 wheel issue, please paste the runner logs here so I can add concrete error lines to the troubleshooting note.

Jake: noted. will ping if CI shows it again. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: link-checker completed for PR #4128 — 3 external links flagged (one is a redirect), 0 broken anchors. Please review the flagged links before publishing.

Maria: thanks docs-bot — will handle the flagged links in a follow-up commit.

Lee: that's it from me. syncing later in the infra standup if needed.

Jake: approved and merged. live in staging. can folks sanity-check the quickstart in staging docs and give a thumbs?

Sasha: quick smoke on staging passed for me. :white_check_mark:

Maria: verifying now, will post any last micro fixes if found.

Jake: thanks all — nice incremental rollout.
